digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge CLI and reconciliation engine
propositions: Canonical CLI surfaces rebar bridge preview and rebar bridge sync as primary while retaining legacy rebar reconcile and rebar.reconcile() as compatibility adapters with documented defaults
Legacy --mode and --filter-local-ids remain supported with preserved post-differ write filtering behavior while canonical --only/--except filters before differ execution

Argument-less rebar reconcile stays dry-run by default and argument-less python -m rebar_reconciler with bridge sync remain live, with reconcile-check as lock-free diagnostic retained in production workflow
Capped sync with --max-changes produces deterministic applied/deferred manifests for explicit values while uncapped live removes temporary manifest per prior behavior
Selection tokens in --only/--except must resolve to existing local IDs or bound Jira keys before lock acquisition; unresolved input exits 2 without differ/apply/persist
Target disappearance between preflight and locked load exits 2, names missing IDs, releases lock, and skips differ/applier/manifest/persistence calls
